WORKSPACE GUIDE
How to use the lab
  1. Choose SQL or Excel, then select a dataset.
  2. Choose an exercise or open the sandbox.
  3. Enter and run your solution. Use Check answer to compare the output with the reference result.
  4. Open a hint or worked solution when you need help.
Datasets and limits
Songs and Chinook are complete course databases. Movies and P-cards use labelled subsets, and their answers apply to those subsets. SQL queries are read-only. Results may contain up to 10,000 rows. The table displays the first 200.
The browser supports a selection of Excel formulas. Employee codes include all 597 rows from ETL Case 3. Payroll includes all 4,981 IntegrateCo 2015 rows with five selected fields. Row 1 contains headers. For other methods, download the same data as CSV and open it in Excel.
Supported functions
LEFT · RIGHT · MID · LEN · FIND · SEARCH · IF · IFERROR · AND · OR · NOT · CONCATENATE · TRIM · UPPER · LOWER · VALUE · ROUND · SUM · AVERAGE · COUNT · MIN · MAX
You can also use +, −, *, /, &, comparisons, cell references and ranges. Use SEARCH with literal text and use decimal points in numbers. This browser stores SQL and formula drafts, selected formula modes, and completed-question IDs. Exam pages also store written answers, attempted-question marks, the current question selection and timer state. Browser storage can be cleared in your browser settings, and work stays with this browser profile on this device. The checker compares outputs on the selected dataset. Use the worked solution to review your reasoning.
